profile.ja: 対魔忍。現在は、東京キングダムを拠点とする独立勢力のボスとして活動する。ふうま一門の頭目衆の一角、二車家の若き当主で、主人公の遠い親戚にあたる。主人公とは幼なじみで蛇子とともに遊びまわった親友であった。しかし成長すると、昼行灯で“目抜け”の主人公に深く失望し、自分こそがふうま宗家を継承するのに相応しいと考え五車に反旗を翻した。得物は二車家に代々伝わる斬馬刀“猪助”。戦いで敗れ去った亡者たちの怨念を身に纏い自らを強化する邪眼“夜叉髑髏”を持つ。
profile.en: He is a Taimanin and currently the boss of an independent force based in Tokyo Kingdom. As the young head of the Nisha family, one of the leaders of the Fuuma clan, and a distant relative of Fuuma Kotaro, he was once a close friend who played with Aishu Hebiko. However, as he grew older, he became deeply disappointed with Fuuma Kotaro's lack of ambition and decided he was the one worthy of succeeding the Fuuma clan, leading him to rebel against Gosha. He wields the "Inosuke", a tachi passed down through the Nisha family, and possesses the "Yasha-Dokuro", an evil eye that enhances his strength by absorbing the grudges of those who have fallen in battle.

text.ja: ちっ、まさか貴様と共闘することになるとはな……いいか、俺を使うからには上手く使えよ
text.en: Damn, I never thought I'd be working with you... Listen, if you're going to use me, make sure you use me well.

text.ja: こんな所でのんびりする為に来た訳じゃねえ。さっさと戦場へ向かうぞ目抜けェ
text.en: I didn't come here to lounge around. Let's get moving to the battlefield, you lazy bum.

text.ja: なに、稲毛屋のアイス？　要らん。……要らんと言っているだろうが
text.en: What's with the Inaho ice cream? I don't need it. ...I'm telling you, I don't need it.

text.ja: 今更貴様と話すことなどない。語るなら刃でだ
text.en: We've got nothing to talk about now. If you want to communicate, use your blade.

text.ja: 権左は俺の忠実な槍だ。それだけじゃねえ、頼りになる頭脳であり、片腕でもある。お前にそんな奴はいるか？
text.en: Dobashi Gonza is my loyal and reliable spear. Not only that, but he's also a valuable head and a trusted right-hand man. Do you have someone like that?

text.ja: 勘違いするなよ、あくまで一時的に共闘するだけだ。作戦が終われば、また敵同士だからな
text.en: Don't get the wrong idea - we're only working together temporarily. Once the mission is over, we're enemies again.

text.ja: 蛇子もいるのか？　ちっ、あの墨だけは二度と喰らいたくねえ
text.en: Is Aishu Hebiko here too? Damn, I don't want to deal with that ink again.

text.ja: ……………………………………………何だ。用がないならどこかへ行け
text.en: ...What do you want? If you've got nothing to say, then leave.

text.ja: 体は斬られれば血を流す。魂が斬られれば、流れ出すのは怨嗟と呪いだ。……貴様の魂は、どんな怨嗟の声を聴かせてくれるんだろうな
text.en: When the body is cut, it bleeds. When the soul is cut, it flows with grudges and curses. ...I wonder what kind of grudge your soul will let out.

text.ja: 夜叉髑髏・累……敵に殺された奴らの怨みを力に変える技だ。ククク……聞こえるぜ、亡者どもの呼び声が
text.en: Yasha-Dokuro: Ruin... It's a technique that turns the grudges of those killed by enemies into power. Hah... I can hear the voices of the fallen, calling out to me.

text.ja: 勝てば勝つほど、足元には敗者どもの怨念が纏わりつく。お前も勝ち上がるつもりなら、よく覚えておくんだな
text.en: The more you win, the more the grudges of the defeated will accumulate at your feet. If you plan on rising to the top, remember that.
